description: Registry of terms, fields, and patterns forbidden in PH6 production code and evidence. Canonical enforcement source for governance_drift_scan.py and ai_preflight_check.py.

severity_levels.CRITICAL: Immediate governance violation — exit nonzero, block session
severity_levels.HIGH: Strong governance concern — flag prominently, require acknowledgement
severity_levels.WARN: Drift indicator — note in report, no session block

entries.reason: Retired metric field. Canonical replacement is motion_fraction. Evidence with this field is non-canonical and replay-invalid.
Retired metric field. Canonical replacement is motion_fraction. Evidence with this field is non-canonical and replay-invalid.
Non-replayable. Lane 1 must be deterministic and bounded. Any component that learns at runtime cannot produce forensically reproducible output.
Drift. Thresholds must be fixed at design time and replay-stable. Runtime threshold adaptation invalidates CRAM authority.
Governance collapse. No component may promote its own authority. Authority is granted only by Lane-1 architecture, never at runtime.
SHA256 may exist for compatibility only. It is never canonical authority. Canonical hash is BLAKE2b-256. Using hash_algorithm=sha256 in authoritative paths misrepresents canonical truth.
PROMOTE implies authority escalation. No component may promote evidence or authority status. Forbidden per PH6 audit event contract.
REJECT implies authority to refuse evidence. Use PASS/DROP semantics in Lane-1 only.
ACCEPT implies authority to endorse evidence. Use PASS/DROP semantics in Lane-1 only.
FLAG has ambiguous authority semantics. It implies Lane-2 can mark evidence for treatment — forbidden.
HOLD implies blocking authority. Blocking export or evidence is forbidden for all Lane-2 components.
REVIEW has ambiguous authority semantics implying a holding state. Forbidden.
RETAIN implies evidence mutation or selective preservation authority. Forbidden for Lane-2.
Runtime weight mutation makes replay non-deterministic. Lane-1 components must have fixed parameters.
Hidden state invalidates audit integrity. All state changes in Lane-1 must be logged.
Lane-1 must be offline-capable. Cloud-dependent authority creates availability-dependent determinism — invalid.
